agency: City Clerk, City of Miami, OK
title: Mayor Parker — All Electronic Communications (6 months)
description:
Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act (51 O.S. § 24A.1 et seq.), 
I request copies of ALL electronic communications sent or received by Mayor Bless Parker 
from his official city email account, city-issued devices, and any personal devices or 
accounts used for city business, for the period covering the last six (6) months.

This includes but is not limited to:
1. All emails from mayor@miamiok.gov and any other city email accounts used by Mayor Parker
2. All text messages (SMS/iMessage) sent/received on city-issued phones
3. All communications via messaging apps (WhatsApp, Signal, Facebook Messenger, etc.) 
   used for city business
4. All calendar entries and meeting schedules
5. All internal memos, notes, and correspondence

Please include metadata (sender, recipient, date, time, subject) for each record.
If any record is claimed exempt, please identify the specific exemption and provide 
a privilege log as required by Oklahoma law.

This request is submitted by Move Weight Foundation, a 501(c)(3) transparency organization.
notes: Targets Parker's outside employment communications, travel coordination, and any discussions about resignation rumors.

agency: City Clerk / Finance Department, City of Miami, OK
title: Mayor Parker — Travel, Expenses, and Budget Records (12 months)
description:
Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act (51 O.S. § 24A.1 et seq.),
I request copies of ALL financial records related to Mayor Bless Parker for the past 
twelve (12) months:

1. All travel expense reports, reimbursements, and per diem claims
2. All credit card statements for city-issued cards assigned to the Mayor
3. All receipts, invoices, and purchase orders authorized by the Mayor
4. The Mayor's office budget, including all line items and actual expenditures
5. Any contracts, bids, or RFPs where the Mayor had signatory authority
6. All discretionary fund expenditures and grant allocations

Please include supporting documentation for each expenditure.
This request is submitted by Move Weight Foundation, a 501(c)(3) transparency organization.
notes: Parker admitted to 'new job requiring travel.' This FOIA establishes whether taxpayer money funds his outside employment travel.

agency: Human Resources / City Clerk, City of Miami, OK
title: Mayor Parker — Personnel File and Employment Records
description:
Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act (51 O.S. § 24A.1 et seq.),
I request copies of the following personnel records for Mayor Bless Parker:

1. Complete personnel file including employment application, background checks, 
   and qualifications submitted for office
2. Any ethics filings, financial disclosure statements, or conflict of interest forms
3. Any complaints, grievances, or disciplinary actions filed against the Mayor
4. Attendance records for all city council meetings, executive sessions, and 
   official city functions
5. Any settlement agreements, legal claims, or litigation involving the Mayor 
   in his official capacity

Oklahoma law is clear: public officials' personnel records that relate to public
duties and public funds are subject to disclosure. Any exemption claimed must be
narrowly tailored with a specific statutory basis identified.

This request is submitted by Move Weight Foundation, a 501(c)(3) transparency organization.
notes: Establishes Parker's outside employment, any ethics complaints, and meeting attendance record.

target: City of Miami Official Facebook Page
agency: City Clerk, City of Miami, OK
title: City of Miami — Deleted/Hidden Facebook Posts and Social Media Policy
description:
Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act (51 O.S. § 24A.1 et seq.),
I request the following records related to the City of Miami's official Facebook page:

1. All content that has been deleted, hidden, or had visibility restricted from the 
   City's official Facebook page (facebook.com/miamiokla) in the past 12 months
2. All logs, records, or documentation showing who authorized content deletion/hiding
3. The City's social media policy, including content moderation guidelines
4. All communications between city officials regarding social media content decisions
5. The identity of all individuals with administrative access to the City's Facebook page

The City's Facebook page is a public forum. Content deletion by a government entity
raises significant transparency concerns under the Oklahoma Open Records Act.

This request is submitted by Move Weight Foundation, a 501(c)(3) transparency organization.
notes: July 9 capture shows City of Miami page had a post hidden/deleted/restricted. This FOIA demands the deleted content and who authorized it.

agency: City Clerk / Finance, City of Miami, OK
title: Miami FY 2026-2027 Budget — Supporting Documents and Interfund Transfer Records
description:
Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act (51 O.S. § 24A.1 et seq.),
I request the following records related to the Miami FY 2026-2027 budget:

1. A General Fund schedule showing the budget with and without interfund transfers
2. A full MSUA transfer schedule and utility-rate impact explanation
3. A past-due MSUA debt aging and recovery report
4. Claims paid in a searchable format with invoice numbers, purchase order numbers,
   departments, funds, contract authority, procurement method, and whether each item 
   was bid, quoted, sole-source, emergency, recurring, or grant-funded
5. Any written Flock/license plate reader surveillance policy or data retention policy

These items were requested during the June 2, 2026 public budget hearing and have not
been made available to the public in the requested format.

This request is submitted by Move Weight Foundation, a 501(c)(3) transparency organization.
notes: Based on Wade Ivy's June 1, 2026 budget hearing statement. City has not published these reports.

agency: City Clerk, City of Miami, OK
title: Mayor Parker — Deleted or Hidden Social Media Content
description:
Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act (51 O.S. § 24A.1 et seq.),
I request records of any and all social media content posted from accounts associated
with Mayor Bless Parker that has been subsequently deleted, hidden, edited, or had 
visibility restricted, including but not limited to:

1. Any content deleted from Mayor Parker's official or personal Facebook profiles
2. Any content deleted from the City of Miami's official social media accounts
   where Mayor Parker was the author or subject
3. Any communications instructing or authorizing the deletion of social media content
4. The City's social media retention policy for elected officials

Government officials' social media posts regarding public business are public records
under Oklahoma law. Deletion of such content may constitute a violation of records
retention requirements.

This request is submitted by Move Weight Foundation, a 501(c)(3) transparency organization.
notes: Surveillance has already captured one instance of City of Miami page hiding/deleting content. Mayor Parker's profiles may also contain deleted posts.
